experiments.hypothesis: The medium-tier run suggested cheaper crews hold quality with review, CI and auto-fix behind them. On hard tasks, give one arm per model (sonnet, grok, terra, muse-wonder) against the live hard pool. That shows which models can carry hard work at lower cost without raising rework, recoveries or escapes. Control reads the live pool, unpinned, by Daniel's choice.
experiments.name: hard-tier-by-model

experiments.hypothesis: Explorer delegation is enabled in [redacted], yet agents made 0 orbit.agent.invoke calls across ~300 offered implement runs (10-19..10-24). Before the trial, opus hard runs averaged 28.1 min, $7.78 and 70% footprint misses (n=125). Forcing two read-only explorer questions before the first edit (the files the change touches, and the tests covering them) should shorten the implementer's own discovery and catch missing footprint early. That would cut implement duration and review repairs without raising cost by more than the explorer's own (haiku/luna) spend.
experiments.name: hard-tier-explore-first

experiments.hypothesis: The 2026-10-27 riskiness backtests found escaped regressions per line changed about equal across crews (per-file spread ~0.8–1.27x, within noise). Either crews are over-qualified for medium work, or the review gate, CI and auto-fix absorb the capability gap at a cost. Randomly assigning medium tasks to the cheap pool (luna, haiku, muse-spark) instead of the current medium pool (sol, muse-wonder) separates the two. If the treatment cuts cost with no rise in rework, recoveries or escapes, medium work is over-staffed. If it matches on escapes but costs more in review repairs and recoveries, the pipeline is paying for the gap.
experiments.name: medium-tier-cheap-crews

experiments.hypothesis: Daniel 2026-10-30 moved Opus to medium effort on hard tasks ('I think medium effort level will suffice for opus on hard tasks'). This check keeps 25% of hard tasks on opus@high, with the same pool otherwise, so a quality loss from medium effort shows up as a gap against the high arm. The arm differs from control only in Opus's effort; Sol is identical in both.
experiments.name: opus-hard-effort-check

verdict.label: collecting
reasons: not every arm has reached min_sample and max_days has not passed
